prompt: CSSFontFeatureValuesMap set method exception too many values
answer:
`CSSFontFeatureValuesMap.set(key, value)` throws an exception when an invalid number of values is passed. If the associated feature-value block permits only a limited number of values, passing too many values is invalid. The method syntax is:

```js
map.set(key, value)
```

The search results do not specify the exception type.
